verdict.rationale: Fern exposes a documented CLI (init, validate, preview, publish) and a public OpenAPI-described API (docs tokens, search, current-user) that let AI-native users script much of the doc/SDK workflow programmatically, and this was confirmed live (CLI installs and runs, openapi.json resolves) [fern-docs-1, fern-probe-rt-3, fern-probe-rt-4]. However, some UI-only capabilities like the no-code Fern Editor, analytics dashboards, and versions/domain configuration are not shown to have equivalent API/CLI coverage. Missing for 10: explicit API parity for Fern Editor content editing, analytics, and admin/config UI features, plus independent confirmation beyond vendor docs.
